description: This file contains functions and types for installing npm packages from archive specs, including handling integrity drift, resolution parsing, and temporary directory management.

methods.name: installFromNpmSpecArchiveWithInstaller
methods.description: Installs an npm package from a spec archive using a provided installer function, with support for integrity checks and timeouts.

methods.name: finalizeNpmSpecArchiveInstall
methods.description: Finalizes the installation result, adding resolution and integrity drift info if the install was successful.

methods.name: installFromNpmSpecArchive
methods.description: Main function to install an npm package from a spec, handling temp directory creation, spec parsing, archiving, resolution, and drift detection.

methods.name: isSuccessfulInstallResult
methods.description: Type guard to check if an install result indicates success.
